leadText: Volume 5: Making Waves is the fifth volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the second volume of four in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Mato.
plainText:
Volume 5: Making Waves is the fifth volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the second volume of four in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Mato. 

==Blurb==
Pokémon trainer Red has vanished... Trainer Yellow Caballero and Red's faithful Pikachu are off to rescue him. But it will take smarts, skills, and a lot of help from friends and other Pokémon to find and rescue Red!

And watch out for the Elite Four, Yellow Caballero... Are you a strong enough Pokémon trainer to defeat all of them?

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 53 - Can't Catch Caterpie!
Chapter 54 - Pidgeotto Pick-Me-Up
Chapter 55 - The Primeape Directive
Chapter 56 - The Coming of Slowpoke (Eventually)
Chapter 57 - Ekans the Ecstasy
Chapter 58 - The Kindest Tentacruel
Chapter 59 - Hitmonlee, Baby! (One More Time)
Chapter 60 - Breath of the Dragonair Part 1
Chapter 61 - Breath of the Dragonair Part 2
Chapter 62 - Breath of the Dragonair Part 3
Chapter 63 - Extricated from Exeggutor
Chapter 64 - Putting It on the Line...Against Arcanine
Chapter 65 - Karate Machop!

==Important events==
 
saves everyone on board the S.S. Anne.
Yellow battles Lance and seemingly defeats him.
battles Bruno.
and find out that Sabrina, Koga, and Lt. Surge are alive.

==Party changes==
===Additions=== 
The following Pokémon are obtained:
Yellow's Caterpie "Kitty" in PS053
===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
Yellow's Rattata "Ratty" to Raticate in PS053

==Character summary==
This is Yellow's Pokédex information and party at the end of this volume.
===Yellow's Pokédex===
Gym Badges: 0
Pokémon seen: 51
Pokémon owned: 9

==Trivia==
The VIZ Media second edition of this volume was released on the same day as Chuang Yi's translation of of Magical Pokémon Journey.
The cover of this volume is orange to celebrate the third anniversary of the release of Pokémon. 

===Errors===
====VIZ Media second edition====
's name is misspelled as "Mewoth" on page 52 and 's name is misspelled as "Slowpoké" on page 63. On page 178, Silph Company is misspelled as "Sylph Company".
In the Elite Four recap on page 199, Agatha's Gengar is listed as Dewgong, likely due to Lorelei's Dewgong being listed in the same format 4 pages earlier.
At the end of the book on page 205, Raticate and Doduo are listed with levels from volume 4 instead of their current ones.
The same page also mistakenly lists Graveler's typing as instead of .
